lines.en: I'm Peppa Pig. This is my little brother, George. This is Mummy Pig. And this is Daddy Pig.
lines.zh: 我是小猪佩奇。这是我的弟弟乔治，这是猪妈妈，这是猪爸爸。

lines.en: Secrets. Mummy Pig has made a special box for Peppa.
lines.zh: 秘密。猪妈妈给佩奇做了一个特别的盒子。

lines.en: Peppa, this box is just for you. Thank you, Mummy. It's a secret box for you to keep secret things in.
lines.zh: 佩奇，这个盒子是专门给你的。谢谢你，妈妈。这是一个秘密盒子，你可以把秘密的东西放在里面。

lines.en: What things can I put in it, Mummy? Only you can decide that, Peppa. It's your secret box.
lines.zh: 妈妈，我可以往里面放什么呢？只有你能决定，佩奇。这是你的秘密盒子。

lines.en: I know what I can put in it. Good. But don't tell me.
lines.zh: 我知道我要放什么进去了。很好。但不要告诉我。

lines.en: I won't tell you or George or Daddy. It's a secret.
lines.zh: 我不会告诉你，也不会告诉乔治和爸爸。这是个秘密。

lines.en: George, this is my secret box. It's empty. I have to find some things to put inside.
lines.zh: 乔治，这是我的秘密盒子。它是空的。我得找些东西放进去。

lines.en: George wants to help Peppa.
lines.zh: 乔治想帮佩奇。

lines.en: No, George. Only I must know what's in the box. You have to wait outside while I choose.
lines.zh: 不行，乔治。只有我能知道盒子里有什么。我挑选的时候你得在外面等着。

lines.en: Peppa is going to choose some secret things to put in the box.
lines.zh: 佩奇要挑几样秘密的东西放进盒子里。

lines.en: Now my secret box is full. George, you must not look inside.
lines.zh: 现在我的秘密盒子装满了。乔治，你不能往里面看。

lines.en: George would like to know what is inside Peppa's secret box.
lines.zh: 乔治很想知道佩奇的秘密盒子里有什么。

lines.en: If you like, you can try to guess. Dinosaur?
lines.zh: 如果你愿意，可以试着猜一猜。恐龙？

lines.en: George thinks Peppa has put a dinosaur in the box. Oh, George, you always say dinosaur for everything. Anyway, a dinosaur is too big to fit in the box.
lines.zh: 乔治以为佩奇在盒子里放了恐龙。哦，乔治，你什么都说恐龙。再说，恐龙太大了，放不进盒子。

lines.en: George cannot guess what is in Peppa's secret box.
lines.zh: 乔治猜不出佩奇的秘密盒子里有什么。

lines.en: Daddy Pig is cleaning a picture. Daddy, this is my secret box. Mummy made it for me.
lines.zh: 猪爸爸在擦一幅画。爸爸，这是我的秘密盒子。妈妈给我做的。

lines.en: It's very nice, Peppa. What's inside? It's a secret. George tried to guess, but he didn't get it right. Can I have a try?
lines.zh: 非常漂亮，佩奇。里面是什么呢？是秘密。乔治猜过了，但没猜对。我能试试吗？

lines.en: Yes. Hmm, have you put my glasses inside? No. Your glasses are around your head.
lines.zh: 可以。嗯，你把我的眼镜放进去了吗？没有。你的眼镜就架在你头上呀。

lines.en: So they are. Silly Daddy! You must have a proper guess. Okay, have you put Mummy's shoes in the box? Nope.
lines.zh: 还真是。傻爸爸！你得好好猜才行。好吧，你把妈妈的鞋子放进盒子了吗？没有。

lines.en: And that's all your guesses used up. Peppa likes secrets. Hmm, no one knows what's in my box. Oh, what has George got?
lines.zh: 你的猜测机会都用完了。佩奇喜欢秘密。嗯，没人知道我盒子里有什么。哦，乔治拿的是什么？

lines.en: I made a box for George, too, and he's filled it with secret things. And only George knows what's inside.
lines.zh: 我也给乔治做了一个盒子，他把秘密的东西都装进去了。而且只有乔治知道里面是什么。

lines.en: Oh! Peppa would like to know what is inside George's box. Is George's toy dinosaur? Of course. No! George's toy dinosaur is not in George's box.
lines.zh: 哦！佩奇很想知道乔治的盒子里有什么。是乔治的玩具恐龙吗？当然了。不对！乔治的玩具恐龙不在乔治的盒子里。

lines.en: It's too difficult. I'll never guess. Peppa does not like secrets as much as she used to.
lines.zh: 这太难了。我永远也猜不到。佩奇不像以前那么喜欢秘密了。

lines.en: Maybe if you showed George one thing from your box, then he could show you one thing from his.
lines.zh: 也许你给乔治看你盒子里的一件东西，他也会给你看他盒子里的一件东西。

lines.en: Okay, but we must do it at the same time. That's a good idea. On the count of three, you each show what's in your boxes. Ready? Yes!
lines.zh: 好吧，但我们必须同时打开。这是个好主意。数到三，你们各自亮出盒子里的东西。准备好了吗？好了！

lines.en: One, two, three!
lines.zh: 一、二、三！

lines.en: George has a drum, and Peppa has a trumpet. Oh, lovely. Yes, it sounds very nice.
lines.zh: 乔治有一面鼓，佩奇有一只小号。哦，真好听。是的，听起来非常好听。

lines.en: Do you have any more secret things? George has a custard donut.
lines.zh: 你们还有别的秘密东西吗？乔治有一个奶油甜甜圈。

lines.en: Oh, but Peppa's box is empty. I've got nothing else.
lines.zh: 哦，可是佩奇的盒子空了。我没有别的东西了。

lines.en: Luckily, I have. Come on, tuck in.
lines.zh: 还好，我有。来吧，开吃。

lines.en: George, Peppa, Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig all like custard donuts.
lines.zh: 乔治、佩奇、猪妈妈和猪爸爸都喜欢奶油甜甜圈。

lines.en: I don't have a special box, but I know a very good place to hide my custard donut. Can you guess where? Hmm. Are you going to hide it in the fridge?
lines.zh: 我没有特别的盒子，但我知道一个藏奶油甜甜圈的好地方。你们能猜到是哪儿吗？嗯。你要把它藏在冰箱里吗？

lines.en: No. Somewhere much more special. My tummy!
lines.zh: 不是。是一个特别得多的地方。我的肚子！

lines.en: Mmm, delicious. I'm going to hide mine in my tummy. Me, too!
lines.zh: 嗯，真好吃。我要把我的藏进肚子里。我也要！
